# cb:b541

> Render a plan in plan-app as a live view over its directive nodes, the way positions already join beliefs. A plan currently references beliefs only in prose; give it the same structural join positions have (PlanApp.BeliefJoin resolves **Belief:** [[id]] refs against the live graph and pills each with active/superseded/dangling state). Then a plan page shows its directives' live status - which are still open desk items, which were materialized, which got superseded - making the plan a dashboard over the obligations it grounds rather than a static doc. Reuses BeliefJoin; needs a plan-side convention for listing directive ids. Holds the b382/b489 boundary: the directive stays the SSOT, the plan is the record/view, never the source of obligation.
